jobs.occupation: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
jobs.description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

• 
Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

• 
Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

• 
Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

• 
Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

• 
Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

• 
Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

• 
Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

• 
Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

 

What we offer

• 
A unique opportunity to work on a high-risk, high-gain research concept exploring a new computational regime between classical probabilistic and quantum computing.

• 
A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing research section with expertise in spintronics, probabilistic computing, neuromorphic computing, analog/digital IC design, and emerging computing architectures.

• 
Access to advanced facilities for electronic design, device characterization, measurement, and system prototyping.

• 
Close collaboration with INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory on spintronic device technology and fabrication.

• 
Opportunities to collaborate with national and international researchers in spintronics, quantum-inspired computing, quantum technologies, and nanoelectronics.

• 
An open, international, and collaborative research environment within SDU's Faculty of Engineering, supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, physics, materials science, and computing.

• 
Strong opportunities for developing an independent research profile in an emerging area of probabilistic and quantum-inspired hardware.

 

What we expect

Applicants should hold a PhD in electronic engineering, electrical engineering, applied physics, nanotechnology, spintronics, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

• 
Spintronics and magnetic devices, particularly MTJs, STT-MTJs, SOT-MTJs, or related technologies.

• 
Physics-based modelling of nanoscale or magnetic devices.

• 
Verilog-A, SPICE, and Cadence or comparable circuit/device simulation environments.

• 
Experimental characterization of electronic, magnetic, or spintronic devices.

• 
Stochastic or probabilistic computing systems.

Experience in micromagnetic simulation, magnetotransport measurements, nanofabrication, probabilistic computing, or quantum/quantum-inspired computing will be considered a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are enthusiastic about working across traditional disciplinary boundaries and are comfortable combining device physics, modelling, experimentation, and computing concepts.

The successful candidate should be able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research team. Excellent written and spoken English and strong communication skills are required.

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, spintronics, photonics, and neuromorphic computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk / email), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section and Associate Professor Hooman Farkhani (farkhani@sdu.dk / email), Deputy Head of SDU Microelectronics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position.

• 
Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

• 
A research statement may be included.

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is February 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Two-year Postdoctoral Position on Spintronics for Advanced Computing: Spintronic Device Fabrication, Characterization and Advanced Computing
jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year position as a postdoctoral researcher within spintronic computing. The position offers an exciting opportunity to advance spintronics through device physics, simulation, fabrication, experimental characterization, and integration of spintronic devices for advanced computing applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to investigate, design, fabricate, and characterize spintronic devices, with particular emphasis on Anisotropic Magnetoresistance (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR), and Tunneling Magneto Resistance (TMR) devices. The work will combine magnetic and spintronic device physics, materials and multilayer structures, device fabrication, electrical measurement, modelling, and data analysis, with the aim of developing reliable spintronic technologies for advanced computing and emerging semiconductor applications.

The research will focus on understanding, controlling, and exploiting thermal fluctuations and stochastic switching in MTJs for physical entropy generation and energy-efficient computing, with particular emphasis on True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and Stochastic Neural Accelerators (SNAs).

The successful candidate will work on the physics-based design, modelling, simulation, fabrication, and experimental characterization of spintronic devices and their integration into advanced computing systems. The position also includes a role in the Danish Chips Competence Center, where the candidate will contribute to connecting the Danish semiconductor and spintronics ecosystem with relevant EU pilot lines, facilitating collaboration, technology development, prototyping, and access to European semiconductor fabrication capabilities. The candidate will also contribute to preparing and writing research proposals and funding applications related to spintronics, semiconductor technologies, and advanced computing.

As a spintronic postdoc, you are expected to: 

• 
Perform atomistic and micromagnetic simulations of s-MTJ structures and magnetization dynamics to investigate switching mechanisms, thermal activation, stochasticity, variability, and operating conditions relevant to TRNG and SNA applications.

• 
Contribute to the electrical, magnetic, and transport characterization of fabricated AMR, GMR, and TMR devices, including resistance states, magnetoresistance, switching behaviour, current/voltage dependence, temperature dependence, and device-to-device variability, and correlate experimental results with modelling and simulation.

 

What we offer 

• 
A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

• 
Access to advanced facilities and infrastructure for spintronic device design, fabrication, electrical and magnetic characterization, and system prototyping, together with opportunities to collaborate with relevant Danish and European pilot-line and semiconductor facilities. 

• 
Excellent opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in microelectronics, semiconductor technology, photonics, spintronics, and advanced computing, including activities connecting the Danish ecosystem with EU pilot lines.

• 
An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), The Mads Clausen Institute (MCI), promoting interdisciplinary innovation across electronics, materials science, semiconductor processing, spintronics, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Electronic and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

• 
Expertise in spintronics, magnetism, magnetic device physics, or related areas, with demonstrated experience in physics-based modelling and/or simulation of magnetic or spintronic devices. Experience with s-MTJ devices, stochastic magnetization dynamics, or thermal switching is highly desirable and electrical modeling of sMTJs using Verilog to be used in Cadense

• 
Experience with experimental characterization of AMR, GMR, MTJ, or related spintronic devices, including electrical and magnetic measurements, resistance and magnetoresistance characterization, switching behaviour, and data analysis. Experience with pilot-line activities, technology transfer, or collaboration with semiconductor foundries is an advantage.

• 
A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

• 
Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners.

The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. jobs.description:

Yayami Sushi & Wok søger to dygtige og kreative medarbejdere – en kok og en sushikok, som brænder for at arbejde med asiatisk mad, à la carte og selskaber.

Som kok eller sushikok bliver du en del af den daglige drift i vores restaurant. Du vil blandt andet arbejde med tilberedning af mad, à la carte, selskaber samt bidrage til menuplanlægning og indkøb.

Før du søger stillingen, tjek venligst, om du kan genkende dig selv i følgende punkter. Vi forventer, at du er/kan:

• 
Fyldt med godt humør

• 
Selvstændig og initiativrig

• 
Imødekommende, pligtopfyldende og serviceminded

• 
Arbejder professionelt, har godt overblik og kan prioritere i hverdagen

• 
Deltager aktivt og tager ansvar for din egen arbejdssituation

Vi søger i alt 2 medarbejdere:

• 
1 kok

• 
1 sushikok

Skriv venligst i din ansøgning, at du fandt jobbet på Jobindex.

As a chef or sushi chef, you will become part of the daily operations of our restaurant. Your responsibilities will include food preparation, à la carte service, catering, as well as contributing to menu planning and procurement.

Before applying for the position, please check whether you recognize yourself in the following points. We expect you to be:

• 
Positive and good-humoured

• 
Independent and proactive

• 
Approachable, responsible, and service-minded

• 
Professional, well-organized, and able to prioritize tasks

• 
Active and willing to take responsibility for your own work

Shifts will typically be between 12:00 PM and 10:00 PM.

We expect you to be comfortable working in a busy kitchen. Experience with Asian cuisine or sushi is an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

We are looking for a total of 2 employees:

• 
1 Chef

• 
1 Sushi Chef

Please mention in your application that you found the job on Jobindex.

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, Swedish Market | Copenhagen Area or Southern Sweden
jobs.description:
Are you fluent in Swedish, based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, and ready to help ambitious restaurants grow? Join DinnerBooking and help us expand our presence in Sweden. 

At DinnerBooking, we are building a booking system that brings restaurants and guests together, and we have a lot of fun along the way. With more than 20 million guest bookings annually and 1,400+ restaurants across 11 markets, we help restaurants reach their full business potential. 

We are looking for a proactive and commercially driven Sales Manager based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, for example Malmö or Lund, to grow our customer base in Sweden. You will combine your Swedish language skills and understanding of the market with a structured approach to outbound sales. 

Why join DinnerBooking? 

Besides building a fantastic product, we take pride in our culture. Your ideas matter, your opinions will be heard, and you will be part of a team that supports each other. 

We are problem solvers, colleagues, and friends who want each other to succeed, both professionally and personally. 

Your role 

You will be responsible for identifying and engaging restaurant customers in Sweden. You will join an ambitious international sales team, share ideas and work together to turn opportunities into lasting customer relationships. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• 
Identifying and contacting potential customers in the Swedish restaurant market. 

• 
Starting conversations through outbound calls, emails, and following up. 

• 
Conducting online meetings and product demonstrations in Swedish. 

• 
Managing the sales process from first contact to signed agreement. 

• 
Maintaining a structured and updated pipeline in our CRM system. 

• 
Working closely with colleagues to ensure a smooth handover and onboarding for new customers. 

What you bring 

• 
You are based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, such as Malmö, Lund, or nearby areas. 

• 
Fluency in Swedish and a good command of English, both spoken and written. 

• 
At least 1 to 3 years of outbound sales experience. 

• 
Confidence in opening doors, starting conversations, and building relationships. 

• 
A structured approach to managing your pipeline and following up on opportunities. 

• 
A proactive mindset and the ability to stay motivated and take ownership of your results. 

• 
An empathetic and energetic personality, with a genuine interest in people and their businesses. 

What you can expect from us 

• 
Responsibility for sales in Sweden. 

• 
An international team with strong commercial experience. 

• 
Training in our product, sales approach, and the needs of our restaurant customers. 

• 
The opportunity to make a direct impact on our growth in Sweden. 

• 
A supportive working environment with room for ideas and professional development. 

• 
A compensation package with a component based on performance. 

Interested? 

Send your application and CV in English. We would love to hear about your sales experience, your connection to the Swedish market, and why you would like to join DinnerBooking.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer – IoT Platform, Load and Energy Management
jobs.description:
🚀 About the role

We're looking for a senior software engineer who writes solid, reliable code and wants that code to control real hardware. At FLEXECHARGE, our HARMON-E platform manages load and energy for EV charging operators across Europe. Part of it runs at the edge, on an industrial PC next to chargers, batteries and solar inverters, and connected to the interfaces DSOs use to curtail load.

You'll build and maintain the TypeScript microservices that talk to those devices and turn their data into decisions. This is not a web-app role. It's software engineering for systems where the other side is physical, stateful and often unreliable.

⚡ What is special about this role

It sits where two worlds meet:

• 
Web and cloud toolchain: TypeScript, Docker, MQTT, Azure, Kubernetes.

• 
Operational technology and system integration: talking to real chargers, batteries and inverters over Modbus and OCPP, running at the edge on an industrial PC.

Your code won't only talk to clean APIs in a data centre. It runs on site, next to real peripheral devices, and has to keep doing its job when those devices and the networks between them don't behave as expected.

We recognize that TypeScript is not typically used for edge computing or hardware interfacing. This is why we're looking for a strong software engineer who is interested in learning new techniques and applications, as well as applying their technical skills in novel ways.

🛠️ What you'll do

• 
Write and maintain a combination of TypeScript microservices and the business logic behind them: control algorithms, scheduling and decision-making, not just plumbing.

• 
Build and extend device drivers for chargers, batteries and inverters over Modbus TCP, using our existing driver services as a starting point.

• 
Work with OCPP, which our platform already supports, as you ramp up.

• 
Run services in containers at the edge and connect them through MQTT and pub/sub messaging to our cloud backend.

• 
Profile and optimise software on edge hardware, where hardware resources are constrained.

• 
Help shape the long-term move of performance-critical services to compiled languages.

• 
Mentor and pair with colleagues on integrations and software craft.

🤔 Why compiled languages, if we write TypeScript?

It may sound odd, so here's the reasoning. Today the majority of our edge stack is TypeScript, and you'll develop in it from day one. Over time we want to move selected services, such as device interfaces and performance-critical paths, to a compiled language while keeping them part of the same stack.

To do that well, you need to understand both sides: the TypeScript services as they are now, and the concepts of memory, types and performance that compiled languages force you to think about. In our experience, it's much easier to go from a compiled language to a scripting environment than the other way around. So if you're a Go, C, C++, Rust or similar developer who is happy to work in TypeScript (or happy to learn), you're exactly who we're looking for.

✅ Must-have

• 
3–5+ years of professional software development, with strong software and engineering fundamentals.

• 
Professional experience in a compiled language (for example Go, C, C++, Rust, C# or Java).

• 
Proficiency in a scripting language, ideally TypeScript, otherwise JavaScript or Python, or a clear willingness to become productive in TypeScript quickly.

• 
Experience writing business logic with stateful calculations and operations, which can self-heal and recover gracefully.

• 
Comfort with asynchronous and event-driven systems that talk to unreliable external components or peripheral devices.

💡 Strongly preferred (but we'll teach it)

• 
Hands-on device or protocol integration: Modbus, serial interfaces, Ethernet/TCP-IP or comparable.

• 
Containerised applications. Docker, Docker Compose or Kubernetes are ideal, but any container technology counts.

• 
Pub/sub and distributed systems, ideally MQTT or another IoT messaging protocol, and an understanding of their reliability concerns.

• 
Working within constrained systems, including profiling software to find where CPU or memory limits bite.

🎁 Bonus, not a requirement

• 
OCPP experience.

• 
Energy, EV charging or power-systems domain knowledge.

• 
Edge deployment experience.

If you don't have these, apply anyway. Strong fundamentals and the right mindset matter more. 💪

🚫 This role is probably not for you if

• 
Your experience is mainly frontend or request/response web apps, with no compiled-language background.

• 
You prefer to stay in one language and aren't interested in working in TypeScript.

• 
You want a pure firmware or PLC role without writing higher-level services.

• 
You don't enjoy debugging the messy cases where hardware doesn't behave as documented.

🌆 What is it like to work at FLEXECHARGE?

• 
Our office is in Frederiksberg: bright, comfortable, and a genuinely nice place to spend your workday.

• 
You're covered with pension contributions.

• 
Lunch is served on-site, and it's delicious, healthy and nutritious.

• 
We enjoy each other's company outside work too, with Friday bars, company events and team-building activities within each team.

• 
You'll have opportunities for individual development.

🤝 Our interview process

Here's roughly what happens once we've had a look at your application:

• 
A first conversation (about 30 minutes) with our recruiter. You'll get a feel for the role, ask whatever's on your mind, and we'll both get a sense of whether this is worth pursuing further.

• 
Time with the team: a conversation with Kasper, our Head of Architecture & Systems, and Robert, our CTO.

• 
A technical stage: one or more interviews with the team, which may include a case exercise and follow-up discussions. These can take place remotely or at our office.

• 
A conversation with Max, our CEO, alongside someone else from the team.

Hiring carefully matters to us. We want to get to know you properly, and we want you to get a real feel for us too. If there's anything we can do to make the process work better for you, tell us.

We'd love to hear from you.

📍 Location & practical details

This is an on-site role based in Copenhagen. Only candidates currently located in Copenhagen, or those who clearly state in their application that they plan to relocate, will be considered.

Please note:

• 
We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

• 
We do not offer relocation services.

🔐 Data privacy (GDPR)

Applications for this role are processed exclusively through The Hub (thehub.io), our recruitment platform, in accordance with their privacy policy and applicable GDPR requirements. As part of our interview process, conversations may be recorded and transcribed via Microsoft Teams, and AI tools may be used to summarise interview notes to support our hiring team's evaluation. Your data will be handled confidentially, retained only during the interview process, and used only for this recruitment process.

For more information or questions please contact us at iva@flexecharge.com

Working at

FLEXECHARGE

FLEXECHARGE is a cleantech scale-up which offers a powerful load & energy management platform, as a SaaS, to help Charge Point Operators (ex: Clever, eOn, etc.) to optimise their charging operations & business. Our mission is accelerate green mobility through our Smart Charging solutions that make charging faster, greener and cheaper. Our vision is to integrate charging infrastructures better with the grid supply and the ever more volatile & growing production of renewable energy. We want to connect electric vehicles with the grid in a whole new way. By seeing electric vehicles not as a risk for our supply grid, but as a crucial asset for the transition towards 100% renewable energy. We do this through constant innovation of new smart charging features which will make us the preferred partner for EV infrastructure owners, developers, and operators.

jobs.occupation: Carpenter / Flooring & Renovation Specialist
jobs.description:
Gulv Master Enterprise is looking for an experienced and reliable carpenter to join our team on a full-time basis.

We work primarily with flooring, carpentry and renovation projects for private customers, businesses and larger renovation projects across Copenhagen and Zealand.

This is a varied role for someone who enjoys practical renovation work and is comfortable taking responsibility for their own tasks. The position is not limited to traditional carpentry. A large part of the work involves flooring systems, subfloors, finishing work and general renovation.

Main responsibilities

Your work may include:

• 
Construction and levelling of subfloors and timber joist systems

• 
Installation of floor chipboard and other subfloor solutions

• 
Installation of parquet, laminate, LVT, click flooring and similar flooring systems

• 
Installation of skirting boards, architraves, trims and finishing details

• 
Installation, adjustment and repair of interior doors

• 
Construction of stud walls and plasterboard walls and ceilings

• 
Small carpentry constructions and boxing-in

• 
Preparation of surfaces and work areas before flooring and renovation work

• 
General carpentry tasks connected with apartment and house renovations

• 
Measuring, levelling and working from basic drawings and construction plans

• 
Coordination with floor installers, painters, electricians, plumbers and other trades

• 
Communication with customers and project managers on site

• 
Ensuring that completed work meets the company's quality standards

Projects range from smaller residential assignments to larger apartment and house renovations.

Qualifications and experience

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Is a qualified carpenter or has significant practical experience within carpentry and construction

• 
Has experience with renovation, service work or residential construction

• 
Can work independently and take responsibility for assigned tasks

• 
Has a strong understanding of measurements, levels and construction principles

• 
Pays close attention to detail and finishing quality

• 
Is comfortable working with skirting boards, trims, doors and finishing carpentry

• 
Has experience with subfloor construction or is willing to develop further within flooring systems

• 
Can use standard carpentry and construction tools safely and professionally

• 
Is reliable, punctual and able to work as part of a team

• 
Communicates professionally with customers and colleagues

• 
Has a valid Category B driving licence

• 
Can communicate sufficiently in either English or Danish to work safely and independently

Experience with any of the following is considered an advantage:

• 
Flooring installation

• 
Timber joist levelling

• 
Floor chipboard installation

• 
Parquet or wooden flooring

• 
Skirting boards and detailed finishing work

• 
Door installation and adjustment

• 
Apartment and house renovations

• 
Plasterboard construction

About Gulv Master Enterprise

Gulv Master Enterprise provides flooring, carpentry and renovation services for private customers, businesses and larger renovation projects.

Our focus is on high-quality workmanship, reliable communication and complete solutions. We aim to deliver projects where the customer experiences professional service from the first visit until the final completion.

Employees are expected to take responsibility for their work, maintain a clean and professional work environment and represent the company professionally when working at customers' properties.

We offer

• 
Full-time employment

• 
Varied projects across Copenhagen and Zealand

• 
Work within flooring, carpentry and renovation

• 
Responsibility and a high degree of independence

• 
Cooperation with experienced floor installers and other construction professionals

• 
Opportunities to develop further within flooring and renovation work

• 
Opportunities for increased responsibility over time

• 
Salary based on qualifications and professional experience

• 
Start date as soon as possible by agreement

Application

Please send your CV together with a short description of your previous work experience.

You are also welcome to include references, certificates or photographs of previous carpentry, flooring or renovation work.

jobs.occupation: Business Controller, Netcompany DK FP&A Team
jobs.description:
Stillingsbeskrivelse

We are looking for a driven Business Controller with a strong motivation for FP&A to join Netcompany DK. You are either a recent graduate or have 1–3 years of experience, and you will play a central role in ensuring timely and accurate management reporting, as well as in-depth analyses of our business and financial KPIs. You will become part of a dynamic team where collaboration across departments and with different stakeholders is a natural part of everyday life.

Your responsibilities

You will become part of a well-functioning and collaborative team where you will have plenty of opportunities to share ideas, learn from colleagues, and grow professionally. Working closely with the Head of Finance NBS and DK, you will take ownership of key aspects of the monthly financial reporting to management. This includes following up on our business areas and preparing presentations.

In addition to being responsible for your own areas, you will have a broad range of stakeholders, where collaboration with the other Shared Services departments in the business is an important part of the role. The position will give you unique insight into the financial value drivers of the company and an understanding of the financial parameters that drive a business.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Conducting business analyses

• Comment on monthly reports for your areas of responsibility

• Contributing to the continuous improvement of the monthly reporting process

• Participating with your own areas of responsibility in the development of our system structure

• Actively participating in the budgeting and forecasting processes

About you

As a person, you are motivated by working with both complex and operational tasks, and you possess the ability to communicate across the organization. You have a proactive mindset and strong business acumen, combined with excellent analytical skills. You take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement, and are motivated by contributing to the development of the organization. With a keen eye for detail and a strong focus on quality, you take pride in delivering accurate results and meeting deadlines in a structured and reliable manner.

To succeed in this role, you:

• Are newly graduated or at the beginning of your career within a Cand.Merc. (Master of Science in Business and Economics), for example Cand.Merc.Fir, Cand.Merc.Asc, Cand.Merc.Aef., or similar education.

• Have experience working in Excel and processing large volumes of data.

• Are initiative-taking and are keen to contribute to improving and developing processes. At the same time, you have an eye for detail and work in a structured manner.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

jobs.occupation: Senior Associate, Group Investments & Financing
jobs.description:
_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investment? Do you thrive with investment analysis, structured problem-solving, and translating complex analyses into strategic decisions? Then Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is the perfect place for you. We are currently looking for a Senior Associate to join our Group Investments and Financing team.

_**The team

**The Group Investments and Financing team is responsible for CIP Holding's balance sheet investment activities and capital allocation priorities, providing decision support to the CFO, CIP management, and CIP's owners. We work as a closely integrated team, delivering high-quality investment analyses and recommendations in collaboration with the responsible Partner and CFO as well as stakeholders across CIP. Our work supports major investment decisions and plays an important role in shaping CIP's long-term growth and strategic direction.

**The role

**As our new Senior Associate, you will help support CIP Holding's investment activities from analysis through to execution. This is an investment-focused role that combines well-developed analytical and strategic capabilities with practical project management and stakeholder engagement. You will work closely with the responsible Partner, the CFO, and colleagues across CIP, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic investment decisions.

You will join a highly motivated environment of talented colleagues with backgrounds from investment banking, private equity, and strategy consulting. The role offers significant responsibility early on and great opportunities for professional development.

You will thrive in a busy environment, balancing multiple priorities while consistently delivering high-quality work.

**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

**

• Support CIP Holding's investments and strategic projects across CIP-managed funds, affiliated GPs, and new CIP companies

• Contribute to the development and refinement of the CIP Holding investment strategy, including capital allocation frameworks and long-term balance sheet planning

• Support the evaluation and execution of tactical allocation decisions, including analysis of investment and divestment opportunities

• Conduct investment analysis, valuation modelling, market assessments, and due diligence on new opportunities

• Support the negotiation of commercial and legal terms with funds, counterparties, and co-investors, alongside the responsible Partner and legal teams

• Manage project timelines, workstreams, and stakeholders across multiple parallel initiatives, ensuring clear ownership and follow-through

• Prepare investment recommendations, decision materials, and presentations for senior stakeholders and the Board

• Structure complex problems and perform thorough analysis to support strategic decision-making

• Collaborate across finance, legal, business development, and investor relations to support transaction execution and strategic initiatives

• Support ad hoc analyses, board materials, and special projects for the Partners and senior team members

**You

**We are looking for a motivated and collaborative professional with a Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline, combined with approximately 2-4 years of relevant experience from investment banking, private equity, management consulting, corporate finance, or a similar analytical environment.

CIP offers an international, intellectually stimulating, and high-performance environment. We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and analytical professional who is focused on developing themselves within strategic investments and capital allocation.

**Key qualifications include:

**

• Strong financial and strategic acumen, with solid valuation, investment analysis, and financial modelling skills

• Experience supporting transaction processes, due diligence, and investment-related analyses

• Ability to structure complex problems and evaluate opportunities and risks across a range of scenarios, with solid numerical skills and attention to detail

• Skilled in project management, with experience overseeing processes, bringing stakeholders together, and tracking multiple workstreams

• Experience with, or interest in, negotiating commercial and legal terms

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency, with the ability to produce high-quality decision materials

• Interest in fund structures, GP/LP dynamics, and infrastructure or renewable energy investments is an advantage

• A proactive and structured approach, with ownership of deliverables and the motivation to move projects forward

• Skilled at building productive relationships and collaborating across teams and functions

• Excellent written and verbal English skills

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.
